description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This vital leadership role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive work environment for nursing staff. You will collaborate closely with the Director of Nursing to implement best practices and maintain exceptional standards of care for our residents.

If you are a compassionate and skilled nursing leader looking to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. This position offers a chance to advance your career in a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland (or eligibility for licensure)
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care or rehabilitation setting
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare environment
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000 based on experience and qualifications.

description:
An urgent opportunity has arisen for a dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This vital role involves providing compassionate and skilled nursing care to residents, ensuring their well-being and contributing to a positive healing environment. We are seeking a professional who is ready to make an immediate impact.
This position requires commitment to 12-hour PM shifts, addressing an urgent need within our facility. You will be an integral part of a supportive team, working to uphold the highest standards of patient care and safety. Your expertise will be crucial in monitoring patient conditions, administering medications, and collaborating with other healthcare professionals.
If you are an experienced LPN looking for a challenging yet rewarding full-time role with immediate availability, we encourage you to apply. Join a team that values your dedication and provides a supportive environment for professional growth.
requirements: Active LPN license in Alabama
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Ability to work 12-hour PM shifts
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
Current BLS/CPR certification

description:
Join a dynamic corporate office in Skokie, IL, as an Operations & HR Coordinator. This pivotal role is perfect for a proactive and highly organized professional eager to manage a broad spectrum of responsibilities beyond traditional HR functions. You will be instrumental in ensuring smooth daily operations, handling everything from office administration to critical HR tasks, including payroll, benefits, and onboarding.

We are seeking a versatile individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can seamlessly manage diverse tasks. This position offers the opportunity to be the central point for operational efficiency and employee support, making a significant impact on our team's success. Experience with HVAC operations or related facilities management is a significant advantage for this role.

If you possess a strong administrative background and are ready to take on a comprehensive role where no two days are the same, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience in an Operations and/or HR Coordinator role.
Demonstrated ability to manage comprehensive office administration tasks.
Experience with payroll, benefits administration, and employee onboarding processes.
Exceptional organizational skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Prior experience or strong understanding of HVAC operations or facilities management is highly desirable.

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President - Client Services to join a leading client services organization in Plantation, FL. This pivotal full-time role is responsible for overseeing overall client relations, ensuring operational effectiveness, driving revenue generation, and fostering strong client retention.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic leader with a proven track record in managing key client accounts and contributing to business growth. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact within a forward-thinking organization.
requirements: Demonstrated experience in Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) is highly preferred.
Proven ability to manage and enhance overall client relations.
Strong background in driving operational effectiveness.
Track record of successful revenue generation and client retention.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team at a premier healthcare facility in Alpine, AL. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $47/hr, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. We value our nurses and provide a supportive environment where you can make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers excellent flexibility for interviews, with availability Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, and over the weekend as needed. We understand the demands of your schedule and are eager to connect with qualified candidates promptly. If you are an RN looking for a rewarding opportunity with a focus on patient well-being, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends as needed
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

description:
Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Occupational Therapist in Alpine, AL, providing essential therapy services in a community-based care setting. This role offers the flexibility of a per-visit compensation model, allowing you to manage your schedule while making a significant impact on patients' lives. We are seeking a passionate professional ready to deliver high-quality, individualized care.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Occupational Therapist who thrives in an autonomous environment and is committed to patient well-being. We value your expertise and offer competitive compensation at $65 per visit. Interview scheduling is flexible, with availability Monday-Friday from 1 PM-7 PM and over the weekend as needed, to accommodate your current commitments.

If you are a skilled OT looking for a rewarding full-time position with a focus on patient-centered care and flexible scheduling, we encourage you to apply. Make a difference in the Alpine community by helping individuals achieve their highest level of independence and quality of life.
requirements: Current Alabama state licensure as an Occupational Therapist (OT)
Master's degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited program
Prior experience in a home health or community-based therapy setting preferred
Excellent clinical, communication, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently and manage a caseload effectively

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a dynamic team providing essential therapy services in the Alpine, AL area. This role offers the unique opportunity to deliver personalized care directly to patients in their homes, fostering a supportive and impactful therapeutic environment.

This position offers a competitive compensation structure of $35 per visit, allowing for earning potential based on your caseload. We are actively scheduling interviews and can accommodate availability Monday through Friday from 1PM-7PM, with additional flexibility for weekend interviews as needed. Join us in making a significant difference in the lives of those you serve.
requirements: Active Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Alabama
Prior experience in a home health or mobile therapy setting preferred
Strong clinical skills and ability to work independently
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
